observation.command: env | sort; echo "=== gh cli ==="; which gh 2>&1; echo "=== git credentials ==="; ls -la ~/.git-credentials ~/.config/gh 2>&1; cat ~/.netrc 2>&1; echo "=== search for token files ==="; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*token*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname ".urbo*" 2>/dev/null | head
